official_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
objective: Provide affordable life insurance cover for death due to any cause.
description: One-year renewable term life insurance offering Rs 2 lakh cover for death due to any reason. Annual premium Rs 436/-. Cover period 1 June to 31 May. Entry age 18-50 years, cover continues up to age 55. Lien period of 30 days for non-accidental deaths for new/rejoining subscribers. Administered through LIC and other life insurance companies via participating Banks/Post Offices.
implementing_agency: Banks, Post Offices, LIC and other life insurance companies
